messages:
alex: heads-up: a user on Vercel Edge hit a nasty TS inference regression with our js/ts SDK. node build is fine, edge bundle returns `any` for parsed responses.

rachel: can you paste the callsite and the relevant overloads?

alex: callsite: `const out = await sdk.chat.create({ model: 'rwd-1', parse: (s) => JSON.parse(s) })` types come back totally unhelpful in their app. our .d.ts uses two overloads (non-generic first, generic second).

samir: that ordering is fragile across CJS/ESM d.ts entry selection. bundlers + `type: module` often cause TS to pick the ESM d.ts which in our build has the non-generic overload first. so inference falls back to string/any.

docsy: is this the same issue where `moduleResolution: 'bundler'` + `module: 'ES2022'` makes tsc behave differently?

alex: yes. they used Vite defaults. repro is trivial locally if you set tsconfig to those options.

rachel: quick mitigation: publish a single exported signature that uses a generic with a default. e.g. `export function create<T = string>(opts: { model: string; parse?: (s: string)=>T }): Promise<T>;` avoids overload ambiguity.

samir: agreed. another option is to put the generic overload first in the emitted d.ts, but that is fiddly because our build pipeline generates re-exports that reorder declarations.

docsy: long-term fix: emit identical d.ts shapes for both CJS and ESM builds (same re-export ordering + declarationMap). also include "types" on the import subpath in package.json `exports` so ESM consumers see the right d.ts.

alex: we should also avoid defaulting the public generic to `any`. prefer `unknown` or an explicit `T = string` so callers get safer types or are nudged to annotate. users complained that `any` silently propagated into their app.

rachel: +1. `unknown` forces handling and is better than `any`. but ergonomics matter; many users expect `string` by default for raw responses. maybe `T = string | unknown` is confusing — better doc the default and offer a typed helper `parseJson<T = unknown>(s: string): T` in the SDK.

samir: small checklist for the PR: 1) make public signature single-generic with `T = string` or `unknown` 2) update build to emit ESM `.d.ts` that matches CJS 3) add `types` subkey in `exports` for import entry 4) add CI typecheck job with Vite-like tsconfig matrix.

docsy: please also add a minimal repro repo under `devex-samples` and a unit that runs `tsc --noEmit` for both moduleResolution strategies. that'll catch regressions.

ci-bot: quickstart / typecheck failed on branch fix/typing-edge (logs: https://ci.redwood/456789/t) :warning:

alex: i'm opening the PR now. will flip to `unknown` by default and include a short migration note in the quickstart README about `type: module` and edge bundlers picking import-entry types.

rachel: when you do that, add a tiny comment in the d.ts near the function explaining the default so users aren't surprised.

samir: i'll review and also check our rollup/esbuild pipeline to ensure `declarationMap` isn't being dropped or that we aren't accidentally renaming type-only re-exports. seen that cause different shapes before.

alex: thanks all. using this thread as the tracker for the CR. will tag people on the PR. :v:
